slots.purpose: A disadvantage is a chain of reasons, and it fails if any one link breaks.
slots.subject: A horizontal chain of four large linked rings, like a simple bicycle chain made of round links. The third ring is cracked open, so the chain is about to come apart there.
slots.composition: The chain runs left to right across the middle of the frame, slightly rising toward the right. The cracked ring sits a little right of centre. Nothing else is in the picture.
slots.colors: The rings are white with black outlines. The crack is a short gap edged in mid grey #7d8690. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No hands, tools or broken pieces flying away.
slots.alt: A chain of four linked rings with the third ring cracked open. A disadvantage is a chain of four parts, and it fails if one part breaks.
slots.caption: A DA is a chain: if one link breaks, the whole argument fails.

slots.purpose: Show the four parts of a DA in order, each with the one question it answers.
slots.diagram_spec: Four rounded boxes in one row, left to right, joined by plain arrows pointing right. Box 1: title 'Uniqueness (U)', line under it 'The harm is not happening now'. Box 2: title 'Link (L)', line 'The plan starts it'. Box 3: title 'Internal link (IL)', line 'The steps from the plan to the harm'. Box 4: title 'Impact (I)', line 'Why the harm matters'. Under the row, one centred line of small text: 'Each part must hold, or the DA breaks.' Ink outlines and text, white fills, light grey #e1e4e8 behind the titles. No blue or red, because the parts belong to the argument, not to a side. On narrow screens the boxes stack top to bottom with arrows pointing down.
slots.alt: Diagram of four boxes in a row joined by arrows: uniqueness, link, internal link, impact. Each box says the question that part of a disadvantage answers.
slots.caption: The four parts of a disadvantage, in the order the neg reads them.

slots.purpose: Uniqueness says the world is fine now but close to the edge, so the plan is what pushes it over.
slots.subject: A large round ball resting on top of a flat, wide table-like ledge, close to the right-hand edge but still fully on top. Past the edge the ledge drops straight down to a low ground line.
slots.composition: The ledge fills the left two thirds of the frame at mid height, its top a long flat line ending in a sharp corner right of centre. The ball sits on the top surface, about one ball-width from the corner. To the right of the corner, a plain vertical drop meets a thin ground line near the bottom. Nothing else is in the picture: no figure, no hand, no arrow.
slots.colors: The ball is white with a black outline. The ledge is light grey #cfd4da with a black outline. The ground line is mid grey #7d8690. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No cliff textures, rocks, grass or sky. No motion lines on the ball.
slots.alt: A ball rests on a flat ledge, close to the edge but not over it. Uniqueness says the harm is not happening now, so the plan is what tips it over.
slots.caption: Uniqueness: the world is near the edge, but not over it yet.

slots.purpose: The link is the first push: what the plan does that starts the chain toward the harm.
slots.subject: A straight row of six tall, plain rectangular dominoes standing on a thin ground line. The first domino on the left is tilted and leaning against the second one, just starting the fall. The other five still stand straight.
slots.composition: The row runs left to right across the middle of the frame with even gaps. The leaning first domino is at the far left. Plenty of white space above and below. Nothing pushes the first domino: no hand or object.
slots.colors: The dominoes are white with black outlines and no dots. The ground line is light grey #cfd4da. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No dots or pips on the dominoes. No hands, fingers or motion lines.
slots.alt: A row of six dominoes where only the first has tipped into the second. The link is what the plan does that starts the chain toward the harm.
slots.caption: The link is the first push: what the plan does that starts the chain.

slots.purpose: Every middle step is a place the argument can fail, and one missing step stops the whole path.
slots.subject: A row of flat round stepping stones crossing a calm stream, from the left bank to the right bank. One stone in the middle of the row is missing, leaving an empty gap of water where it should be.
slots.composition: Seen from a slight angle above. The left bank is at the left edge, the right bank at the right edge, the stream a wide flat band between them. Five stones cross the water in an even line; the gap is the third position. No people, no animals, no plants.
slots.colors: The stones are light grey #cfd4da with black outlines. The banks are white with black outlines. The stream is flat light grey #e1e4e8, with two or three plain straight ripple lines in mid grey #7d8690. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No blue water. No bridges, boats or figures.
slots.alt: Stepping stones cross a stream from bank to bank, but one middle stone is missing. Each internal link is a step, and one weak step breaks the chain.
slots.caption: Each middle step is a place the chain can break.

slots.purpose: The impact is the end of the chain that gives an argument its weight.
slots.subject: A short chain of three round links hanging straight down from a plain horizontal bar. At the bottom of the chain hangs one large, heavy, round-topped weight, like a simple kettlebell shape with no markings.
slots.composition: The bar runs across the top of the frame. The chain hangs from its centre. The weight sits in the lower half of the frame, clearly the largest and darkest shape. Lots of white space on both sides.
slots.colors: The bar and chain links are white with black outlines. The weight is a flat solid ink #16191d shape with no markings. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No numbers or marks on the weight. No hooks with text, no ceiling details.
slots.alt: A chain hangs from a bar with a heavy weight at its end. The impact is the end of the chain, and it gives an argument its weight with the judge.
slots.caption: The impact is the "so what": it gives the argument its weight.

slots.purpose: Show which aff answers attack which part of a DA, and which answers are offense and which are defense.
slots.diagram_spec: Top row: four rounded boxes left to right, joined by plain right arrows, titled 'Uniqueness', 'Link', 'Internal link', 'Impact' (ink outline, light grey #e1e4e8 fill, as in disadvantages-four-parts). Under each box, a short column of answer chips joined to it by a thin vertical line. Under Uniqueness: 'Non-unique'. Under Link: 'No link', then 'Link turn'. Under Internal link: 'No internal link'. Under Impact: 'Impact defense', then 'Impact turn'. Defense chips have an ink outline and white fill. Offense chips ('Link turn', 'Impact turn') have a blue #0055b8 outline and blue text, because they are aff offense. A thin dashed ink line joins 'Link turn' and 'Impact turn' with a small label on it: 'Not both: double turn'. Below everything, one wide chip across all four columns: 'Weighing: case outweighs, case turns the DA'. A small key at the bottom right: white chip = 'Defense: makes the DA smaller'; blue-outlined chip = 'Offense: a reason to vote aff'. On narrow screens the four columns stack top to bottom.
slots.alt: Diagram of the four parts of a DA, each with the aff answers to it. Link turn and impact turn are marked as offense, with a warning not to use both on one DA.
slots.caption: Each part of a DA has its own answers. Turns are offense; the rest is defense.

slots.purpose: A few general DA shapes are prepared once and fit almost any plan, like a ring of keys.
slots.subject: One plain round key ring holding six simple keys. Each key has a round or square head and a different, simple blade shape, so no two keys are the same.
slots.composition: The ring sits a little above centre. The six keys hang down and fan out evenly below it, like an open hand of cards. No door, lock or hand in the picture.
slots.colors: The ring and keys are white with black outlines. The key heads are light grey #cfd4da. No blue or red.
slots.avoid: No locks, doors or hands. No engraving or marks on the keys.
slots.alt: A key ring holding six different keys. Common DA shapes, like politics and spending, are prepared once and fit almost any plan.
slots.caption: A few DA shapes come back every year, because they fit almost any plan.
